name: Balor
_terrain: Turtle's island west of Stormwind Harbor. All tiles are Turtle's; the ones a 3.3.5 client does not have are added to Azeroth.wdt.
_terrain_tiles: 18 island tiles + ocean around it (column 23, row 50) so the sea does not end at the island. Seams against the 3.3.5 tiles were checked (heights match).
_ship_assets: Ship the Turtle buildings (WMO), textures and minimap images these tiles use.
_area_templates: 3.3.5 area whose flags (and its subzones' flags) the new zone copies: Duskwood.
_taxi_nodes: Turtle flight masters: SI:7 Outpost (Alliance, to Sentinel Hill) and Stormbreaker Point (Horde, to Grom'gol).
_lights: Turtle's stormy sky/fog for the island (Light.dbc rows), ported with their LightParams/bands under new ids.
_force_display: Turtle-made models with no 3.3.5 file: Tidecaller Mrglrar -> murloc oracle, Kilrogg Deadeye -> Nazgrel (orc chieftain).
_exclude_quests: Empty: 'To The Darkest Places' (gossip scripts, converted by the build) and 'Explosives Make My Heart Go BOOM!' (manual/046_balor.py) are both ported.
_extra_creature_templates: Creatures with no spawn: the invisible quest-credit NPCs for 41694 and 41698, and the Abysstide Siren that the Tidal Altar summons for 'Calming The Tempest'.
_extra_spawns: Marine Hornby (Stormwind Harbor) and Ronald Gillian (Stormwind City): they start 'A Hydromancer's Curiosity' and 'My Darling Wife'.
